packageRules.description: Automerge routine updates once CI is green; majors stay manual

The project ships the Spring Boot 4 module line — Boot/SCG majors are framework migrations, not routine bumps. The Gradle plugin is listed by its marker name too: without it the Boot plugin's v4 major got through (#223).
ClassGraph 6 needs Java 25 and the published libraries stay on a Java 21 floor, so it would break consumers on 21. 5.x is the last line that runs there.

The fallback-jdk21 CI job installs JDK 21 on purpose, as the test launcher that keeps the serde fallback paths honest (every other setup-java step is 25). Renovate read that pin as a dependency and proposed 25 (#338).

This project's own modules. Renovate resolves them on Maven Central and proposed moving the project version itself (#234). The version changes only in the release commit, and the sample/BOM pins by hand as part of a release.
